summary: Implemented the versioned workspace codec and fail-safe local storage with adversarial scoped tests.

artifacts.name: impact-codec-handoff.md
artifacts.content: Implemented `examples/impact-planner/src/codec.js` with closed schema validation, UTF-8 size and component limits, unsafe-key rejection, deterministic canonical serialization, and immutable normalization. Implemented `examples/impact-planner/src/storage.js` with safe absent-state loading and exception handling. Added adversarial codec and storage tests in the declared test files. Ran `node --test examples/impact-planner/test/codec.test.mjs examples/impact-planner/test/storage.test.mjs`: 5 passed, 0 failed.
